title: SQS messaging in one screen
rememberThis: SQS delivers at-least-once — design idempotent consumers; never assume exactly-once from the queue alone.
Standard queue: best-effort order, nearly unlimited throughput. FIFO: .fifo name, MessageGroupId for parallel ordered streams.
Visibility timeout must exceed p99 processing time (often 6×). Too short = duplicate processing; too long = slow recovery.
Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) + maxReceiveCount isolates poison messages — alarm on DLQ depth, not just main queue.
Lambda SQS trigger: use ReportBatchItemFailures for partial batch retry; tune batchSize and reserved concurrency.
bullets: Long polling (WaitTimeSeconds=20) reduces empty ReceiveMessage calls and cost.
FIFO deduplication: content-based or explicit MessageDeduplicationId within 5-minute window.
SNS → SQS: queue policy must allow sns.amazonaws.com principal with source ARN condition.
EventBridge → SQS: rule target with input transformer; dead-letter on rule for delivery failures.
